name: argus-starter-v1
description: Hand-authored development benchmark. Discovery and evaluation tasks are disjoint. Three small cases demonstrate the machinery only.

discovery.task: What is the project name? Answer using only the name.

cases.task: What color is the badge? Reply with the color only.

evidence.text: The badge color is green. Each visitor receives a badge at the front desk.
The badge color is green. Each visitor receives a badge at the front desk.

cases.task: Return only a JSON object with the integer field quantity from the invoice.

evidence.text: Invoice 82 contains a quantity of 14. This quantity was verified by the receiving team.
Invoice 82 contains a quantity of 14. This quantity was verified by the receiving team.

cases.task: Write only a Python function named double that returns its integer argument multiplied by 2. Use one return statement.

evidence.text: The interface takes one integer and produces one integer. Both positive and negative values are allowed.
